title: Lomtiiɗo Toɗɗaaɗo oo
intro: Limre ummoraade e duuɓi ɓennuɗi ina darii ina heppi naatde e daartol. Nde laawol ngol wayi no laaɓaani, sikke ina yaaji e nder yimɓe ɓee, ooɗoo maccuɗo suɓaama ngam ƴettude mantol ardorde. E teddungal njillu ceniingu e dow koyɗe maɓɓe, ɓe njalti ngam ardaade ɗo woɗɓe njiɗi rewde.
clues: Mi suɓaama ngam yahdude e annabi gooto, mi janngi e hakkillaaji maɓɓe
Mi darii yeeso Laana kaa nde fodoore Joom men ndee ɓadtii, mi yi’i yimɓe ɓee ina puɗɗii sikkitaade
Mi waɗaama daraade e damal ko fodanoo ko, gardiiɗo men ina mettina, ina ñaagoo Alla ngam men
Mi toɗɗaama ngam jokkude golle ɗe goɗɗo rokkanoo ko adii kam
Mi hokkaama baawɗe Alla ngam ardude e yimɓe ɓee haa ɓe njogori yahde
Mi dañii timminde ko fuɗɗii ko adii am, mi heɓi jaɓde yimɓe ɓee e ardorde am

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
